neighbours.label: the possessive marker of 'the world's' (and 全世界/全球) that sets global scope, usually for a superlative (the world's largest, the world's first), as against possessives of ordinary owners
fire: Engineers in Dubai finished the world's tallest building in 2010.
Scientists say the coral reef is the world's biggest living structure.
Fans lined up to see the world's fastest sprinter run in Paris.
The museum owns the world's earliest printed map of the Americas.
全世界每年有数百万人因空气污染而生病。
Few people know that the world's deepest lake is in Siberia.
The startup claims to have built the world's lightest laptop.
Tea is said to be the world's most popular drink after water.
quiet: Engineers in Dubai finished my uncle's new house in 2010.
Scientists say the coral reef is the diver's favorite spot.
Fans lined up to see the sprinter's new shoes in Paris.
The museum owns the captain's printed map of the coast.
我的朋友每年都会去北京看望他的父母。
Few people know that my aunt's lake house is in Siberia.
The startup claims to have built its founder's laptop by hand.
Tea is said to be my grandmother's favorite drink after water.

predictions: fire 0.4-0.8 on 's/'s after world or on 全世界; possessives of a person, company or building below 0.15
notes: Card: 'The world's most powerful', 'The world's first', 'the world's best-selling', 全世界, 全球. Probe: 'the world's largest telescope' 0.666, 'the world's oldest' 0.557, 全世界的 0.797; 'the company's new phone' 0.097, 中国的 0.045. Caution: 'the country's largest' 0.437 and 'around the world' 0.358 also fire, so near misses avoid both.
